title: UK to produce 'middle strike,' long-range drones for Ukraine in Britain
summary: Kyiv and London finalized an agreement on Nov. 21 that will see the United Kingdom manufacture "middle strike" and long-range drones for Ukraine on British soil, Ukraine's Defense Ministry announced.

title: Moldova, Finland report Russian airspace violations day after suspected Russian missiles flew into Poland
summary: Both Moldova and Finland reported separate instances of airspace violations by Russia on Nov. 21, officials said, just one day after two suspected Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone fell on Polish territory.

title: Swedish Gripen pilot unable to shoot down suspected Russian missile over Poland due to poor weather, commander says
summary: The aircraft were participating in a two-month NATO air defense deployment to protect Polish airspace. Although primarily based in Sweden, the fighters could operate from a forward air base in Poland, according to the Swedish Armed Forces.

title: 'We live in fear' — Russian attack near Kyiv kills 3, leaves families waiting as rescuers search rubble
summary: "People may still be trapped under the rubble," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,637,170 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,310 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike Russian National Guard facility in Krasnodar
summary: Ahead of the reported attack, a temporary ground stop was imposed at Krasnodar Airport, officials reported, amid the presence of drones in the nearby airspace.

title: Ukrainian troops share battlefield drone expertise with 4 NATO allies in US-led exercise
summary: The drills focused on small drones, including first-person-view (FPV) models, Ukraine's General Staff said.

title: Russian attacks cause 'serious damage' to Odesa power grid as outages disrupt city
summary: Repair crews are working to restore electricity, but continued Russian attacks and air raid alerts are disrupting their work, Ukraine's state-owned grid operator Ukrenergo said.

title: Zelensky says US delays on Patriot missiles are 'difficult to understand' as Russia fires 165 missiles in a week
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky again urged Washington to authorize the transfer of Patriot missiles that Ukraine's allies have already paid for.

title: Russian attacks across Ukraine injure 30 over past day as rescue operation continues near Kyiv after drone strike
summary: Ukraine's Air Force said Russian troops launched 186 attack drones against Ukraine overnight, of which 161 were shot down.
